mapper.select: SELECT c.course_no AS courseNo , c.course_name AS courseName , c.course_score AS courseScore , c.course_classroom AS classroom , p.user_name AS professorName , ct.course_time_yoil AS courseTimeYoil , ct.course_time_start AS courseTimeStart , ct.course_time_end AS courseTimeEnd FROM tb_course c JOIN tb_sysuser p ON c.professor_user_no = p.user_no LEFT JOIN tb_course_time ct ON c.course_no = ct.course_no WHERE c.course_no = #{courseNo}
